title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES TRANSFERRING TO THE PRICE STABILIZATION CORPORATION CERTAIN POWERS AND FUNC TIONS OF THE IMPORT CONTROL BOARD AND THE IMPORT CONTROL ADMINISTRATION.

text.en:
The powers, duties and functiors now exer-
cised by and/or vested by law in the Import Control
Board/or Import Control Administration with respect to
applications for and issue of licenses for the importation
of articles listed in the Appendix hereto attached are
hereby transferred to the Price Stabilization Corporation
hereinafter designated as FRISCO.

The Monetary Board of the Central Bark of
the Philippines shail certify to the PRISCO from time to
time the amount of exchange available for any specified
period for the importation of said articles.
SEc. 3. The PRISCO shall promulgate such rules and
regulations as may be necessary for the proper enforce-
ment and/or implementation of this Order.
SEc. 4. The PRISCO shall collect a fee of one per cent
(1%) on each import license issued by it pursuant to the
provisions of this Order covering any of the articles listed
in the Appendix hereto attached, which fee shall be based
on the amount shown on the license Such fee shall
accrue to the General Fund of the Government.

In order to insure the orderly an expeditious
processing, handling, and issuance of import licenses cov-
ering the articles listed in the Appendix hereto attached,
this Order shall become effective on January 1, 1951.

Effective immediately, the PRISCO shall take
possession and shall have custody of all records, documents,
correspondence, papers, etc. of the Import Control Board
and /or Import Control Administration, pertaining to the
importation and licensing of the articles listed in the
Appendix hereto attached, and shall take such steps as
may be necessary for the immediate implementation and
execution of this Order upon its effectivity.

Any violation of the rules and regulations issued
by the PRISCO to carry into effect the provisions of this
Order shall subject the offender to the penalties prescribed
in section 20 of Republic Act No. 426.
Done in the City of Manila, this 21st day of December,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
